title: Lumen
description: An architecture conceived as a dialogue between lines, light, and volumes.This project explores the balance between natural materials and bold geometries, creating spaces where fluidity and character meet.The kitchen is structured around a sculptural island in California Burl wood, while the living area plays with height, transparency, and lush green accents that bring an internal sense of breathing space.The upper floor includes three bedrooms, designed as calm and luminous retreats where simplicity enhances comfort.
